audience.programmeDescription: Groningen’s Dutch Language and Culture track studies Dutch literature from the Middle Ages to the present, the structure and history of Dutch, and how people use it. Students apply these methods in research workshops and a thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers introductory Dutch, psycholinguistics and courses in literary interpretation and rhetoric. Groningen’s track develops sustained study of Dutch-language literature and of how Dutch has changed and is used. The table shows the complete Groningen curriculum.

componentNotes.y2-06: Complete workshops in two different areas chosen from literature, linguistics and language use.
componentNotes.thesis: Before starting, complete at least 50 EC from year one, earn at least 100 EC in the degree overall, and pass Research Approaches.
